title: How NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture Secures and Governs AI Agent Workloads at Scale

Autonomous agents can work for hours on complex tasks, accessing files, tools, the internet, and spawning other agents to collaborate with. Executing complex tasks over long time horizons leads to compounding risk: the agents may download code, build new tools, request additional privileges, and touch more of the underlying infrastructure. The agents’ action paths are determined as they work…
